title: Instant search with infinite scroll repeats records
body: **Describe the bug 🐛** Instant search page with infinite scroll enabled, repeats records/products randomly after 4-5 pages **To Reproduce 🔍** Go to https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=InfiniteHits.default Click on "show more" button 4 to 5 times and observe the results loaded. You should see that some products have repeated. **Expected behavior 💭** Records/products should not repeat. **Screenshots 🖥** **Environment:** - OS: MacOS - Browser: Chrome - Version: 66.0.3359.181

comments.body: Hi @JanPetr  I think this is a duplicate of #2928. Can you check if you have latency in your requests?
@JanPetr Can you try with the latest InstantSearch.js (2.7.5)?
@JanPetr confirmed he can't reproduce it anymore so let's close that :)
